subject: reasoning
question: Statements: Some keys are locks. Some locks are doors. Conclusions: I. Some keys are doors. II. All locks being keys is a possibility.
solution:
**Statements:** Some keys are locks. Some locks are doors.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4abf2c0d4da317a0fef99c9f7527a1c635176de4d6a077916883492ffb9d05a.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some keys are doors. - False (There is no definite relation between keys and doors, it can be possible but it is not definite)

II. All locks being keys is a possibility. - **True** (There is no definite relation between keys and doors, it can be possible but it is not definite)

Thus, only Conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
